entities.name: Murder of Khursheda Sultonova
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The murder of eight-year-old Tajik girl Khursheda Sultonova was committed in Saint Petersburg on 9 February 2004 by Russian neo-Nazis, members of the extremist group sometimes referred to as the "Combat Terrorist Organization", led by Dmitry Borovikov. The crime caused wide public outcry in Russia; media often referred to it as "the murder of the Tajik girl".
